description: An oil-style painting of an ornate, pale stone colonial building with a tall bell tower on the left and a balcony crowded with men in suits. Two flags fly from the roof, a US flag on the left and a Cuban flag with a white star on the right, and figures wave from the rooftop. Below, a dense crowd of men in straw boater hats and dark suits raises their arms, with small Cuban flags among them. The dress and architecture suggest the early 1900s, and I see no visible text, frame, or gore.
